---
title: "Publications"
---

Working papers currently under review or in progress, followed by my
journal articles, books, and reports, organised by year (most recent
first).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false

library(bibtex)

clean_title <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\{\\{|\\}\\}", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[{}]", "", x)
  x
}

format_authors <- function(author) {
  nms <- vapply(author, function(p) {
    given <- paste(p$given, collapse = " ")
    family <- paste(p$family, collapse = " ")
    full <- trimws(paste(given, family))
    if (identical(family, "Sibande") && grepl("Xolani", given)) {
      full <- paste0("**", full, "**")
    }
    full
  }, character(1))
  if (length(nms) == 1) return(nms)
  if (length(nms) == 2) return(paste(nms, collapse = " and "))
  paste0(paste(nms[-length(nms)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", nms[length(nms)])
}

# Build an SSRN abstract link from a field like "Available at SSRN 6764772"
ssrn_link <- function(x) {
  id <- regmatches(x, regexpr("[0-9]+", x))
  if (length(id) == 0) return(NULL)
  paste0("https://ssrn.com/abstract=", id)
}

bib <- unclass(read.bib("my_papers.bib"))

entries <- lapply(bib, function(e) {
  a <- attributes(e)
  journal <- e$journal %||% NULL
  is_ssrn <- !is.null(journal) && grepl("ssrn", journal, ignore.case = TRUE)
  is_wp   <- identical(a$bibtype, "TechReport") ||
             identical(a$bibtype, "Unpublished") ||
             is_ssrn ||
             identical(e$institution %||% "", "Working Paper")

  list(
    bibtype   = a$bibtype,
    title     = clean_title(e$title %||% ""),
    author    = format_authors(e$author),
    year      = suppressWarnings(as.integer(e$year)),
    journal   = if (is_ssrn) NULL else journal,
    volume    = e$volume,
    number    = e$number,
    pages     = e$pages,
    publisher = if (!is.null(e$publisher)) clean_title(e$publisher) else NULL,
    doi       = e$doi,
    is_wp     = is_wp,
    ssrn_url  = if (is_ssrn) ssrn_link(journal) else NULL
  )
})

print_entry <- function(e) {
  cat("- ", e$title, ". ", e$author, ". ", sep = "")
  cat("<span class='pub-venue'>")
  if (!is.null(e$journal)) {
    cat("*", e$journal, "*", sep = "")
    if (!is.null(e$volume)) {
      cat(", ", e$volume, sep = "")
      if (!is.null(e$number)) cat("(", e$number, ")", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(e$pages)) cat(", ", gsub("--", "-", e$pages), sep = "")
    cat(". ")
  } else if (e$is_wp) {
    cat("Working Paper. ")
  } else if (!is.null(e$publisher)) {
    cat(e$publisher, ". ", sep = "")
  }
  cat("</span>")
  if (!is.null(e$doi)) {
    cat("[https://doi.org/", e$doi, "](https://doi.org/", e$doi, ")", sep = "")
  } else if (!is.null(e$ssrn_url)) {
    cat("[Available at SSRN](", e$ssrn_url, ")", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

published <- Filter(function(x) !x$is_wp, entries)
working_papers <- Filter(function(x) x$is_wp, entries)

if (length(working_papers) > 0) {
  cat("\n::: {.pub-year}\nWorking Papers\n:::\n\n")
  working_papers <- working_papers[order(-vapply(working_papers, function(x) x$year, integer(1)))]
  cat("\n::: {.pub-list}\n\n")
  for (e in working_papers) print_entry(e)
  cat("\n:::\n")
}

years <- sort(unique(vapply(published, function(x) x$year, integer(1))), decreasing = TRUE)

for (yr in years) {
  cat("\n::: {.pub-year}\n", yr, "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  yr_entries <- Filter(function(x) x$year == yr, published)
  # Order alphabetically by title within a year
  yr_entries <- yr_entries[order(vapply(yr_entries, function(x) x$title, character(1)))]

  cat("\n::: {.pub-list}\n\n")
  for (e in yr_entries) print_entry(e)
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
```
